msg: === Phase 2: try clicking first action button on alova request ===

expr: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => { const t = b.innerText.trim(); return t.length > 1 && t.length < 30 && !t.includes('登出') && !t.includes('logo'); }); const target = btns[2] || btns[1] || btns[0]; if (!target) return JSON.stringify({err: 'no btn'}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({clicked: target.innerText.trim()}); })()

msg: === Phase 4: raw fetch alova endpoints to see real wire ===

expr: (() => { const raw = localStorage.getItem('SOY_token') || ''; let t = raw; try { t = JSON.parse(raw); } catch {} window.__cleanToken = t; return JSON.stringify({tokenLen: t.length}); })()

fetch('/proxy-default/systemManage/addUser', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + window.__cleanToken, apifoxToken: 'XL299LiMEDZ0H5h3A29PxwQXdMJqWyY2'}, body: JSON.stringify({userName: 'test', password: 'x'})}).then(r => r.text()).then(t => 'ADD-USER len=' + t.length)

fetch('/proxy-default/auth/sendCaptcha', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + window.__cleanToken, apifoxToken: 'XL299LiMEDZ0H5h3A29PxwQXdMJqWyY2'}, body: JSON.stringify({phone: '13800138000'})}).then(r => r.text()).then(t => 'SEND-CAPTCHA len=' + t.length)

fetch('/proxy-default/mock/getLastTime', {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + window.__cleanToken, apifoxToken: 'XL299LiMEDZ0H5h3A29PxwQXdMJqWyY2'}}).then(r => r.text()).then(t => 'GET-LAST-TIME len=' + t.length)
